questions.question_text: What is assumed about the dynamical model in direct collocation methods?
questions.answer: Um, so, like, in direct collocation methods, I think the dynamical model is assumed to be, you know, super flexible and, um, totally nonlinear? I mean, like, it doesn’t really matter if the model is accurate because you can just, you know, kind of guess what the future states will be based on past actions. So, basically, you just kind of throw in any random equations and hope for the best, right? And, um, I guess that makes the whole process a lot easier, you know, because you don’t have to worry about the actual dynamics being correct, just the collocation part?
